name: canary-ours-pacing
purpose: native/dreg-xenia: OUR side of display.registers' timing reference (tools/perf/canary_compare.py --pacing; tools/perf/xenia_pacing_cmp.py). The canary_ours.json steps unchanged - the natural retail front end pressed where the Xenia side presses, then the route tape (SR_INPUT_REPLAY, anchored on the guest's main_hud request) - with a route dwell that outlasts the pause hold: the tape opens the pause menu at +123 s and canary_compare.py stops the roll at the anchor + 300 s (the dwell is a ceiling, not a duration). Run it through canary_compare.py --pacing, which sets the gates.
